ms:

A1
oe, e.g. y = −2x + 3

B1 for each
accept −1.1 to −0.9 and 1.9 to 2.1
FT their line from (a) if it is linear
the line is a tangent to the curve at x = −1

B1
oe: the line touches the curve there instead of crossing it, so that solution is repeated
sols: The curve is y = x³ − 5x + 1 and the line is y = mx + c.

A cubic can meet a line three times, but here the line only touches at x = −1.
The line is a tangent to the curve at x = −1, so that solution is repeated.
the factorised form (x + 1)²(x − 2) = 0 shows the repeated root
